route: C2: Professional Player or Artist (Directorate General of Immigration and Emigration)

permit.applies: The artist applies to the Directorate General of Immigration and Emigration (online, through Irembo)
permit.first: An employment contract and a recommendation letter

sources.title: Directorate General of Immigration and Emigration (Rwanda), Permit services: Employment
sources.said: C2: Professional Player or Artist … Permit issued to a professional player or artist. REQUIREMENTS FOR RECURRING APPLICATION * The copy of employment contract. * Detailed Curriculum Vitae. * Recommendation letter * Original police clearance from the country of residence for the previous six months. REQUIREMENTS FOR A RENEW APPLICATION * The copy of employment contract. * Recommendation letter APPLICATION FEES * 100,000 Frw PERMIT VALIDITY *up to two years

sources.title: Irembo (Government of Rwanda e-services), Frequently asked questions about permits
sources.said: What is the processing time of the permit application? The processing time of permits is 7 days. … The processing time of permit renewal is 7 days.
